title: Joker Face MIUI 14 ROM on Xiaomi 11T Pro Full Feature Tour
blurb: Joker Face MIUI 14 on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — a tuned MIUI build with a Leica camera, iOS emoji and a long list of small fixes that add up.
video_description:
Joker Face MIUI 14 on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — a tuned MIUI build with a Leica camera, iOS emoji and a long list of small fixes that add up.

This is modded MIUI, not an AOSP port, so the phone still feels like a Xiaomi. Same control centre, same settings tree, same gestures. What changes is the detail work: the build is cleaned up, the camera app is the newer Leica one, and a pile of stock annoyances have been patched out. I walked through every screen I could in the clip and the phone held up — banking apps opened normally and the Play Store showed up certified.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi 11T Pro
🧩 ROM     : Joker Face MIUI 14 (14.0.1)
🧰 Type    : Modded MIUI build

🧩 What's Inside
• Thunder animation while charging
• iOS emoji set baked into the system
• SafetyNet passing by default
• Newer MiuiHome v2 running on MIUI 14
• New Leica camera app
• Battery health screen added
• Extended power menu
• Notification groups and a screenshot frame
• Extra features in MIUI Lab under Accessibility
• Automatic screen refresh-rate adjustment
• Unlimited Google Photos
• Super icon unlock, and no root needed for it
• Debloated: MiuiBugReport, MiuiDaemon, MiBrowserGlobal and Updater are gone
• Control centre MiPlay bug fixed

💡 Best Part
It behaves like a daily driver instead of a project. Certified Play Store, unlimited Google Photos, banking and payment apps opening without complaints, and the MIUI layout you already know — just tidier underneath.

🚫 Worth Knowing
The camera is Xiaomi's Leica app, so don't expect the Google camera processing you'd get from an AOSP ROM. And MIUI 14 keeps its own quirks — a modded build fixes plenty of them, not every single one.

📝 Before You Flash
1. Back up anything you care about.
2. Reboot to recovery and format data if you're coming from a different base.
3. Flash the ROM zip and let it finish.
4. Reboot to system and set the phone up fresh.
